weather.quip: Open-Meteo has Mill Valley starting Monday at 55°, feeling like 53°, very humid, cloudy, and breezy from the west-southwest around 10 mph. The local forecast climbs to about 74° with almost no rain, UV around 7.6, sunrise at 6:21 AM, and sunset at 8:09 PM. wttr sees the same 55° start but runs much hotter later, so assume the exact afternoon temperature depends on where you are in the Mill Valley microclimate maze.
